daily.title: Transport Minister forced to take back seat at his own press conference
daily.summary: The premier and his senior lieutenants have been grilled on multiple occasions in the past fortnight about the biggest and most expensive road infrastructure project in SA's history but debate continues over whether it's time for one minister to fall on his sword.

daily.title: American democracy has spoken but will Donald Trump listen?
daily.summary: These midterm election results are an emphatic defeat for the US president, but anyone who thinks he is a lame duck does so at their own peril.

daily.title: The Democrats have won control of Congress. What now?
daily.summary: Democrats have made a plan for their first 100 hours of House control, but still face barriers to advancing their agenda.

daily.title: Shops reporting suspicious fuel purchases in bid to curb firebombings
daily.summary: A luxury car workshop is the latest business to be targeted in Melbourne's ongoing arson attacks.

daily.title: Australian banks lift interest rates
daily.summary: Australia's banks reveal they will raise their interest rates in response to the RBA's decision to lift the cash rate for the fifth time in 2026.

daily.title: Former NRL player charged with manufacturing illegal peptides
daily.summary: Trent Merrin is facing five charges following a police investigation that allegedly led to the discovery of a "clandestine lab".

daily.title: Breaking: Democrats gain control of Congress in rebuke to Trump
daily.summary: The Democrats have won the Senate and are on the cusp of taking the House of Representatives as well, in a stunning victory over Donald Trump's Republican Party.

daily.title: ASIC fines Mona owner David Walsh's company for late financial report
daily.summary: The parent company of Tasmania's Mona museum has been slugged with a hefty fine after failing to lodge a financial report on time.

daily.title: David Jones on brink of collapse and behind on rent to Westfield
daily.summary: One of David Jones's biggest landlords says the department store is in breach of its rental agreements and has not paid since September.

daily.title: Queensland, NT governments block UN youth detention visits
daily.summary: The United Nations says its special rapporteur investigating human rights issues affecting Indigenous Australians has been blocked from visiting two youth detention centres.

daily.title: China Southern Airlines suspends direct Darwin to China route after one year
daily.summary: China Southern Airlines will suspend its direct flights between Darwin and Guangzhou, China after just one year operating in the NT. The airline's final scheduled flight to China will be on December 3.

daily.title: NSW man in court over alleged ice seizure at Tasmanian beach car park
daily.summary: A New South Wales man has appeared in a Tasmanian court accused of being involved in trafficking in both methamphetamine and cocaine.

daily.title: Journalist quizzed over 'nail in the coffin' remark at Jones trial
daily.summary: Reporter Kate McClymont has been questions in Alan Jones's indecent assault trial over messages she sent about the broadcaster to a complainant's mother.

daily.title: Fake jobs and malicious code used by hackers in largest crypto-heist
daily.summary: Binance, the crypto-exchange platform at the heart of the sector's largest heist has uncovered how hackers stole billions in funds.

daily.title: Staggs says he means no harm by refusing to sing Australian anthem
daily.summary: Kotoni Staggs has earned criticism for staying silent during the Australian anthem at the Rugby League World Cup, but says his decision is a personal one.

daily.title: Former councillor pleads not guilty to stalking senior shire staff
daily.summary: A former Shire of Esperance councillor has pleaded not guilty to stalking two senior employees at the local government.

daily.title: Lobster fishers rail against salmon industry's antibiotic plans
daily.summary: Tensions have escalated between Tasmania's salmon industry and the wild seafood sector over plans to close some fishing areas when antibiotics are used in salmon pens.

daily.title: Five-year-old seriously hurt in e-bike strike outside school
daily.summary: A young boy was taken to hospital in a serious condition after being hit by an e-bike outside a primary school in Tahmoor, south-west of Sydney.

daily.title: Collins Dictionary names 'mogging' its word of the year
daily.summary: The word, which has origins in bodybuilding circles, has become a slang term for outshining someone or something.

daily.title: Melbourne Salvos cafe closes as demand exceeds capacity
daily.summary: The Salvation Army is searching for a new venue for its Lighthouse Cafe in Melbourne's inner west after being overwhelmed by those in need of free meals.

daily.title: Jailed former MP pleads guilty to misusing parliamentary allowance
daily.summary: Former MP Troy Bell, who is already serving a jail sentence for theft and fraud offences, has pleaded guilty to misusing the Country Members Accommodation Allowance.

daily.title: Indonesia detains police generals suspected of wire-tapping president's phones
daily.summary: Indonesian police detain three senior police generals on suspicion of illegally wire-tapping the phones of President Prabowo Subianto and other prominent figures between 2025 and 2026.

daily.title: Gold Coast triple header as Tszyu goes for two-weight glory
daily.summary: Tim Tszyu will lead an all-star cast of fighters as Robina Stadium hosts the biggest Australian boxing card since Jeff Horn beat Manny Pacquiao at Lang Park.

daily.title: Assault on One Nation volunteer not being treated as politically motivated
daily.summary: Victoria Police has issued a fresh statement regarding the assault of a One Nation volunteer to clarify detectives are not treating the incident as politically motivated.

daily.title: Canberra man's murder conviction reinstated by High Court
daily.summary: The High Court has reinstated Michael O'Connell's murder conviction, ordering the case to return to the Court of Appeal.

developing.title: Live: Tax office boss concedes consultation failures on credit card ban
developing.summary: The head of the tax office says he would have consulted more closely with small businesses if he had his time again, conceding the ATO should have had a more open conversation before rolling out the credit card ban. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: US staring down December and March rate hikes as Fed leaves rates on hold
developing.summary: The US Federal Reserve has held interest rates unchanged at its most recent meeting, but in Australia, high inflation data means we're likely to hike. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

developing.title: Live: Erin Patterson awaits appeal decision on mushroom murder convictions
developing.summary: Three judges from Victoria's Court of Appeal will hand down their judgment on Erin Patterson's appeal against her murder convictions and on the prosecution's appeal over her sentence.

developing.title: Live: Federal government launches probe into future of Australia Post
developing.summary: Communications Minister Anika Wells says a parliamentary inquiry will examine whether Australia Post is keeping pace with Australians' needs for the future. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: ASX set to edge up despite $US500b Alphabet share slump overnight
developing.summary: The Australian share market is likely to rise on opening this morning with ASX 200 futures up 15 points overnight. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: South Africa extends lead over Australia as new ball taken
developing.summary: Pat Cummins ends his lengthy drought with a crucial strike before the lunch break on day four in Cape Town. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Jillaroos running over World Cup minnows Wales with try-scoring blitz
developing.summary: Australia has already qualified for the semifinals of the women's Rugby League World Cup, and will be keen to continue their momentum with a win over Wales. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Albanese to seek tighter rules for British backpackers in meeting with UK PM
developing.summary: Anthony Albanese will seek a tightening of rules for British backpackers coming to Australia when he meets his UK counterpart this week. Follow live.
